title: Chapter 1235
text:
"I said that we would meet again sooner or later … I just didn't expect this day to come so soon."

EsGod said with a playful smile.

Han Xiao's pupils constricted.

This body is not an empty shell?

His first reaction was that he had guessed Gaud's identity wrongly and released EsGod instead.

However, hearing EsGod's words, Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he asked, "How are you so sure that I will release you?"

"Oh? You didn't release me to ask for my help? " EsGod raised his brows. "You didn't make such a big fuss just to open the amber to see if I'm dead, right?"

Ask for help? That's right, EsGod knew about the World Tree Civilization and left behind the wormhole data. Maybe he felt that when the advanced civilizations discovered the World Tree Civilization, they would most likely release him to ask about the situation, so he said that he would meet again sooner or later?

The Spacetime Amber isolated everything. Although his soul was not frozen, it was still trapped in his body. EsGod knew nothing about the outside world in the past few decades, and his impression of the universe was still the same as when he was captured.

The mental communication happened in a flash, and their movements were not slow at all.

Hu!

EsGod retreated immediately and was about to teleport away when he realized that he was in a spacetime locked area, and teleportation was useless. He quickly analyzed the strength of the encirclement and confirmed that he could not break out using normal methods. He immediately changed his mind and started to use the Dimension Crevice ability to infiltrate this area … As long as he created a crack, he would be able to escape.

Although he did not know why the dynasty released him, to him, breaking out of the encirclement and escaping was the most important thing.

On the other side, Han Xiao immediately took action, leading dozens of Apostle Weapons and many mechanical troops to surround and kill EsGod. No matter what was going on with EsGod, since he was not an empty shell, he had to be sealed again.

The dynasty fleet around began to attack, and all kinds of control-type weapons were fired one after another. Dark red energy filled the starry sky in an instant.

The flames of war suddenly erupted!

EsGod's figure was drowned in the endless firepower in the blink of an eye, bobbing up and down.

"Back then, eleven Beyond Grade As besieged me before finally succeeding. Black Star, you're alone now. Can you catch me?"

Through the mental link, EsGod's tone was playful. Despite being heavily surrounded, he did not panic.

After his evolution, the burden on his genetic chain was greatly reduced, and his personal strength was undoubtedly at the top of the universe. Although he had just come out of the Spacetime Amber and his soul was in a weak state, he did not have the time to prepare dozens of Beyond Grade A doppelgangers. However, EsGod also had the ability to convert between energy and blood.

Relying on [Esper Ability — Black Hole] to convert the enemy's attacks, replenish his own energy, and then use the Regeneration Esper Ability to maintain high health regeneration. Back then, Han Xiao had obtained the ability to strengthen his health conversion from EsGod.

If EsGod was given the time to prepare a few dozen doppelgangers in advance, he would probably be able to solo the Celestial Star Alliance worlds that he had been to before. Currently, most peak Beyond Grade As were no match for EsGod. Coupled with his various slippery Esper Abilities, he was basically invincible.

If not for the fact that he was hit by Han Xiao's Super Silence, which stopped all his Esper Abilities and wiped out all his doppelgangers, even eleven Beyond Grade As would not have been able to catch him.

Thankfully, Han Xiao and the dynasty had made preparations in advance. EsGod's escape ability was crippled, and his most troublesome ability was frozen. His threat was greatly reduced, or else he would have been able to escape as soon as he escaped.

However, this was not foolproof. Although the dynasty had used all kinds of advanced spacetime locking devices, if the battle dragged on for too long, EsGod would still have a chance to escape.

"You'll know once you try. I'm no longer who I was back then. I don't need any help to deal with you."

Han Xiao chose a portion of his weapons to fuse with, and the Mechanical Deity suddenly appeared. It immediately chased after EsGod and slashed at him, leaving behind sparks and lightning.

Although EsGod had many abilities, he could not use too many at the same time. Thus, he solved this problem through doppelgangers, giving part of his Esper Abilities to his doppelgangers. The more doppelgangers there were, the more abilities he could use at the same time.

Doppelgangers required a large amount of energy, and he could absorb energy. Thus, as the battle progressed, the number of doppelgangers would gradually increase, and EsGod would become stronger the more he fought.

However, EsGod did not prepare any doppelgangers in advance and could only slowly create them during the battle. Han Xiao's dozens of Apostle Weapons were not to be trifled with. As soon as EsGod created a doppelganger, it would immediately be killed by the Apostle Weapons. There was no way he could accumulate them.

Thus, the situation was clear. All kinds of factors were not in EsGod's favor, and he could only passively take a beating.

Although he also had the ability to switch between health and mana, the cost was far greater than Han Xiao's. [Esper Ability — Black Hole] had a limit and could not block all damage. The upper limit of his regeneration ability was also limited. Han Xiao's lethality was not what it used to be, and with the support of the dynasty army, EsGod's health was dropping faster than his health regeneration.

After a few decades, the level difference between Han Xiao and EsGod had shrunk a lot. He opened the interface and looked at the combat information. More information about EsGod appeared.

He quickly glanced at it and did not see [Esper Ability — Rebirth] in EsGod's ability column. He did not know if it was among the few 'question marks'.

You are in the [Moderate Weakened Soul] status. Your Mental Resistance has decreased by 30%. Your INT and MYS have decreased by 15%. Duration: Unknown

You are in the [Soul Torn] status. You have lost a large amount of INT and MYS. Your Basic Mental Resistance has decreased by 60%. Duration: Constant

"This …" Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

The Weakened Soul should be the side effect of being imprisoned by the Spacetime Amber, and there was still a chance to recover. However, this [Soul Torn] status clearly had nothing to do with the Spacetime Amber. The effect just happened to match Gaud's overly high attributes.

So, I didn't guess wrongly. EsGod and Gaud are indeed related?

It could be ruled out that Gaud was a doppelganger created by EsGod with his Esper Ability. Under the effect of Esper Silence, all Esper Abilities stopped, and Gaud's existence had nothing to do with EsGod's Esper Ability. Back then, when EsGod was captured, he did not have the chance to create a doppelganger. In that short period of time, the only thing he could do was control his soul.

Therefore, EsGod did not just transfer his soul. Instead, he made up his mind and used some kind of Esper Ability to tear his own soul apart, escape with his tail, and merge into Gaud's body. The remaining soul remained in his original body …

The Spacetime Amber isolated everything, so it could not be controlled remotely like Lord's Descent. Furthermore, Gaud had existed outside for so many years, so it should be EsGod's main consciousness in his body.

At this time, the various detection devices of the dynasty fleet did not detect any abnormal soul waves. This meant that this' EsGod's' body was not controlled remotely.

Therefore, the two souls were now completely separated and became two independent entities?!

This meant that the active 'EsGod' might not be the EsGod he knew but a new personality and consciousness based on the remaining soul and memories in his brain, just like a clone. EsGod's main consciousness was actually in Gaud … or was it the other way around?

If that was the case, EsGod would be EsGod, and Gaud would be Gaud. Even if their personalities and memories were almost the same, they would be different people … Could this be what [Esper Ability — Rebirth] meant?

His original body was a Beyond Grade A, and Gaud also became a Beyond Grade A Super. This b * stard turned them into two different Beyond Grade As … If Gaud's main consciousness is really in him, then he's really ruthless.

Han Xiao had all kinds of thoughts in his head.

If the two souls maintained a connection and shared their perspectives and memories, this would be an obvious flaw. With EsGod's personality, if he was determined to clear his name, he would not leave such a flaw behind. Therefore, he might have completely cut off the connection between the two souls.

Not only did he abandon his old body, but he also did not mind having another 'him' in the universe, giving all the strength he had accumulated in the past to 'others'. How daring.

If that was really the case, all the memories of this' EsGod 'about Gaud were probably deleted by EsGod's main consciousness when they' separated '. This was to prevent the dynasty from digging out relevant information from EsGod's brain when they dissected EsGod one day.

As expected of the "Superpower God" who had a bunch of strange abilities, he really had a wild way of doing things.

Han Xiao ran through all kinds of possibilities in his mind while controlling his troops to surround EsGod.

The situation was completely one-sided. EsGod was bathing in psionic energy. His flesh melted and regenerated time and time again. Under the coverage of the super large firepower, he had a hard time moving forward and was completely on the defensive. He did not dare stop regenerating his health at all and suffered huge damage every second.

His regenerating health was constantly catalyzing cell division. Every time he repaired his body, it consumed the vitality of his cells and burned his lifespan. If not for the Evolution Cube giving him a wave of replenishment in the past, he would not have been able to withstand such an intense battle.

Feeling Han Xiao's terrifying army, EsGod was shocked.

He remembered that when he was frozen, Black Star was not even a peak Beyond Grade A yet. However, with the strength that Han Xiao was displaying now, even EsGod did not dare say that he had a high chance of winning. Even if he was at his peak, if they fought fair and square, it would most likely end in a draw.

How many years has it been? Black Star has already caught up to my level and is even showing signs of surpassing me!

"Your growth is truly unbelievable! I've never seen someone as talented as you! "EsGod exclaimed from the bottom of his heart.

"Don't think that I'll cut you one less time just because you praise me."

Han Xiao continued attacking expressionlessly. The thing that he was least afraid of now was Espers. Fighting Espers gave him additional attributes and damage bonuses.

Also, the [Elderly Killer] ability was quite useful in beating up old people like EsGod …

Although the evolved EsGod was strong, he was not any weaker!

Round after round of cannon fire landed on EsGod's body, and the scene was extremely tragic. EsGod left behind explosions of light along his path like a long snake.

After continuing to attack for a while, Han Xiao estimated that his various talents had stacked to the max. Suddenly, his eyes flashed, and Mechanical Force shot out.

Ka la ka la!

The armor on the forehead of the Mechanical Deity suddenly slid open, and a pile of mechanical structures gushed out, turning into an exquisite mechanical crown that was embedded on top of his head.

The next moment, with the crown as the center, an invisible wave that seemed to be able to penetrate one's soul burst out, condensing into a wave and hitting EsGod in an instant.

EsGod's body trembled as though he had suffered a heavy blow. It was as though a sledgehammer had smashed into his consciousness.

This was the Universal Treasure equipment that Han Xiao had learned from Jayz's technology treasure, the exclusive equipment of the Mechanical Deity — [Spirit Breaker Crown]!

It sounded like a magical item, but it was actually a mechanical creation. Its principle was to reverse decompose psionic energy and extract psychic energy from it. In the state of the Mechanical Deity, the Spirit Breaker Crown could provide the Mechanic with extremely high psychic resistance while also being able to launch psychic attacks.

The weaknesses of ordinary Mechanics were their body and mind, and they were also extremely lacking in psychic attacks. The effect of this Gold equipment could make up for this weakness to a certain extent. Although Han Xiao was not a proper Mechanic, the Spirit Breaker Crown was still useful to him.

The negative status on EsGod made his mind his biggest weakness. Han Xiao was used to attacking the enemy's vitals, so he naturally would not let go of such an opportunity.

Without waiting for EsGod to recover, Han Xiao immediately activated his Virtual Soul, easily passing through the judgment and dragging EsGod's soul into the virtual world to beat him up.

EsGod's vitals were hit consecutively, and he instantly received tons of damage.

Taking advantage of EsGod's dizziness, Han Xiao's main body left the Mechanical Deity, grabbed EsGod's neck, activated the Spacetime Amber, and immediately started to create a prison.

EsGod recovered very quickly and wanted to struggle. Seeing this, Han Xiao directly pressed EsGod into his broad chest and said with a deep voice, "Don't move.

"Don't move. Do you still remember how I caught you? If you do it again, you won't just end up in jail. You'll end up dead!"

Hearing this, EsGod's counterattack paused, and he immediately remembered the psychological trauma of being hit by Esper Silence.

He did not know about the Character Summon Card and did not know why Black Star would use this move. At this moment, he could not help but think that Black Star still had this ability.

"Compared to an endless prison sentence, why don't I fight to the death?" EsGod narrowed his eyes.

He did not have the right time, place, or people, and this was already a desperate situation that could threaten his life. After experiencing the battle just now, EsGod knew that there was no way he could escape. If Black Star used Esper Silence, he might really die here today.

"Are you sure you want to die?" This time, Han Xiao's eyes turned, and he whispered, "Don't you want to see the day the World Tree descends?"

“！！！”

EsGod's body suddenly froze, and shock finally appeared on his face.

He had always thought that he was the only one in the entire universe who knew about this. He did not expect to hear it from Han Xiao.

When did Black Star find out?

"Could it be that … you guys have already researched that set of data?"

EsGod's eyes sparkled.

Han Xiao did not answer and pretended to be meaningful. "If you surrender obediently, you will still have a chance to be released to witness everything. If you die here, there will be no hope."

"…"

EsGod's expression was uncertain as if he was in a dilemma.

However, after a few seconds, he understood the situation. His body relaxed, and he stopped struggling.

He raised his head, looked straight into Han Xiao's eyes, and slowly said, "I don't believe you.

"I don't believe that you'll let me out … But I'm willing to go to the gambling table. After all, I have nothing left to lose.

This is the second time I've fallen into your hands. Maybe you can really step into the level I'm looking forward to and see the scenery there for me … "

At this time, Han Xiao took a step back without saying a word and completed the creation.

The next moment, EsGod's body froze, and he was once again trapped in the Spacetime Amber.

The only difference was that he was in a different position …

Seeing this, Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief and shook his head.

"If you had struggled, I might not have been able to hold you in place … Sorry, all's fair in war."
